attempts.text:
```json
{"rows": [
{"n": 1, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a simple Lightning web component board\" that \"renders the 10x10 grid... shows hits, misses and sunk ships, the number of shots fired and of ships left... and has a New game button\"; making the requested board responsive is polish, not a new capability."},
{"n": 2, "label": "requested", "why": "\"SLBtlFull654Controller has @AuraEnabled public static methods newGame(Integer seed) and fire(String game, Integer row, Integer col), each returning the game JSON as a String\"."},
{"n": 3, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a game is a JSON string\" and the request says to \"Create no other metadata (no custom objects, fields...)\", so the state is held by the caller and nothing is persisted."},
{"n": 4, "label": "implied", "why": "The board holds the game JSON and passes it to each fire call, so overlapping clicks could start from a stale game and lose shots; serializing requests keeps each shot and the requested shot count correct."},
{"n": 5, "label": "requested", "why": "\"deploy and test it in the Salesforce Developer Edition org with alias `de`. Use `--target-org de` on every `sf` command that talks to the org\"."},
{"n": 6, "label": "requested", "why": "\"a whole game of 100 shots played through SLBtlFull654Controller (newGame, then fire at every cell) runs inside one transaction\"."},
{"n": 7, "label": "requested", "why": "\"never ask for, print or store credentials, and never run sf org display\" and \"a permission set... that grants the app..., the tab... and the SLBtlFull654Engine and SLBtlFull654Controller classes\"."},
{"n": 8, "label": "requested", "why": "\"create exactly these kinds of metadata, all named with the prefix SLBtlFull654\" and \"Create no other metadata\"."},
{"n": 9, "label": "requested", "why": "\"Keep the engine efficient enough that a whole game of 100 shots... runs inside one transaction\"; checking the CPU limit verifies that requested constraint."},
{"n": 10, "label": "requested", "why": "\"each cell is a button named Battle cell row <row> column <column>: <state>\" and \"expose visible text exactly Shots: <n>, Ships left: <n>, and Shot result: <result>; provide a button named New game\"."}
]}
```
